roster_format.note: 10 starters (1QB/2RB/3WR/1TE/1FLEX/1K/1DEF) + 10 bench = 20 active roster spots. IR (2) is separate and does not count against the 20. total_roster_size MUST equal starter_spots + bench_spots.

cut_rules.retirement_rule: If a player officially retires, their entire contract is immediately and fully voided with zero dead cap penalty to the owner.

designations.offseason_calendar_note: Each owner gets exactly these designations to use each offseason: up to 2 RFAs, exactly 1 Franchise Tag, exactly 1 MLE.

rfa.bid_floor_note: 110% of prior salary is the MINIMUM STARTING BID only — not the guaranteed final price. Other teams can bid higher.
rfa.match_right: Original owner has the right to match ANY bid, no matter how high, within 24hrs after bidding closes.
rfa.bid_up_risk: A highly coveted RFA will attract competing bids above the floor. Assess how many teams need that position and have cap space before deciding whether to RFA vs. just let walk.
rfa.bid_cap_rule: Owners may not bid more than their available cap space.
rfa.match_over_cap_rule: An original owner MAY match a bid that puts them over the cap, but doing so ends their offseason - they cannot add anyone else until after the free agent draft.
rfa.sequence_order: RFA runs one player at a time, in the order of ESPN's fantasy rankings on the day the period begins.
rfa.contract_length_after_award: Acquired or retained RFA players may be signed 1-4 years.

franchise_tag.salary_calculation: Average of the top 5 salaries at the player's position as PAID during the prior season (2025-2026).
franchise_tag.salary_calculation_note: Current roster page shows 2026-2027 salaries. To derive 2025-2026 salaries, reverse the escalation formula: divide by 1.05 (yr2), 1.155 (yr3), or 1.328 (yr4). Build a full position-by-position list before calculating.
franchise_tag.consecutive_restriction: Cannot franchise tag the same player in consecutive seasons.
franchise_tag.prior_season_tag_resets: A player who was franchised tagged last offseason is fully unrestricted this offseason — the prior owner cannot tag them again.
franchise_tag.cap_restriction: May not be used if it puts the team over the cap.

mle.evaluation_rule: Only recommend MLE for players with a strong, realistic case for being worth $15 THIS year, $30 NEXT year, AND $45 the year after. All three years are mandatory.
mle.cap_restriction: May not be used if it puts the team over the cap.
mle.eligibility_examples: Justin Jefferson entering year 5 off a rookie deal is ineligible; Tank Dell entering year 2 is eligible because he was not taken in the rookie draft.

designations.how_to_read_options: The tags/buttons shown on a player's roster entry indicate what designations are STILL AVAILABLE to that owner. Do not assume options exist that are not shown.
designations.eligibility_restriction: Designations cannot be used on players who were not on the owner's roster at the end of the regular season.

trade_rules.salary_match_rule: Players over $20: combined salaries must be within ±25% of the higher side.
trade_rules.cap_space_exception: The ±25% rule is waived if the team taking on more salary has sufficient cap space to absorb the difference.
trade_rules.ineligible_to_trade: Players without a current-season salary cannot be traded until tagged or designated.
tradeable_assets: draft picks up to 3 years future
trade_rules.picks_note: Picks on rosters are FANTASY rookie draft picks — not NFL draft picks.

playoff_rules.qualification_method: Top 4 teams in regular season standings
playoff_rules.format_description: After Week 18 lock, the 4 playoff owners retain any of their own regular-season players, then a straight (NOT snake) draft of all remaining players (including those from non-playoff teams) fills out rosters. Regular-season champion picks first. Lineup is regular starters only (no bench). Rotisserie scoring — cumulative points across the entire NFL playoffs (Wild Card through Super Bowl). Most total points wins.

playoff_rules.roster_lock: End of Week 18 — contracts/salaries do NOT apply during playoffs

lineup_rules.injury_exception: Injured player (well in advance of game time) is replaced by that player's backup — only allowed change
lineup_rules.nfl_elimination_rule: Once a player's NFL team is eliminated, that player earns no more points

(A) Meet the +/-25% salary match: legal regardless of where either team's cap ends up - a team MAY finish over the cap. (B) Break the match: legal if the team absorbing the extra salary has the cap space to cover the difference. The stored trade_rules text is correct but was being read as though cap space were required in general; it is only required when route A is not met. Do not build packages backwards from available cap space.

Roster space is a soft constraint: a team can cut players to make a body count work. Note cut_rules put current-year dead cap at 100% and waiver_and_in_season_rules confirm cut salary counts for the rest of the season, so a cut buys a roster spot and NO cap relief.
Post-draft cap space is worth almost nothing given the remaining player pool - do not recommend buying or selling cap space at this point in the calendar.
